mr_title: Optimized RoutePattern by using string operations for converter-less routes.

expected_issues.title: String fast path breaks lazily translated routes
expected_issues.description:
The new fast path for non-endpoint routes passes self._route to str.startswith() and removeprefix(). A gettext_lazy route is a translation proxy, so matching an included URL prefix without converters raises TypeError.

Endpoint routes use equality, which a lazy proxy supports, and are not affected by this particular failure. Convert the prefix with str() at match time, preserving the current language rather than caching its translation.
